claims.statement: Construct and classify a finite collective joint-law lift for three paired binary agents: prove that Q_kappa(x)=P_theta(x)+kappa chi(x) D(theta), on x in {0,1}^6, theta in (0,1)^6, and fixed |kappa|<1, is a strictly positive normalized smooth lift whose every proper marginal is the corresponding product marginal; identify exactly its paired-complement and explicitly admitted finite-coordinate-relabeling boundary; prove its smooth right-inverse, immersion, Fisher rank, radical, and quotient statements; prove the fixed-outside agent-block local/global VFE difference and differential; derive the general signed joint-score residual formula and the parity-family positive-definite residual theorem, including the exact center metric and weighted-marginal equality gate; construct the declared three-agent hyperedge record witness; and prove by explicit boundaries and a two-bit counterexample that kappa, full-joint VFE, and full-joint Fisher are extra lift-dependent structure rather than consequences of the six singleton Bernoulli sections grouped into three agent pairs.
claims.quantifiers: For every theta in (0,1)^6 and every fixed real kappa with |kappa|<1, the six-bit construction and its proper-marginal, smoothness, right-inverse, immersion, symmetry-boundary, Fisher, and residual conclusions hold. For every paired agent block A, every strictly positive normalized target T, and every pair of strictly positive normalized recognition laws Q and Q' with a common outside marginal, the stated finite VFE difference identity holds; its differential holds for every normalized fixed-outside conditional tangent. There exists the displayed binary-record hyperedge kernel with posterior Q_kappa at theta=(1/2,...,1/2), and there exists the displayed two-bit lift whose Fisher correction relative to the product marginal metric is indefinite. Quotient-manifold conclusions are only conditional on the separately stated constant-rank, integrability, regular-leaf-space, and basicness hypotheses.
claims.falsifier: Any scope-satisfying finite counterexample to a universal conjunct, or failure of an existential record or two-bit witness, refutes the corresponding target conjunct.

claims.statement: For every theta in (0,1)^6 and fixed |kappa|<1, Q_kappa has 64 strictly positive atoms and unit total mass.
claims.quantifiers: For every admitted theta and kappa.
claims.falsifier: One nonpositive atom or nonunit sum in the admitted open domain refutes the claim.

claims.statement: Every proper subset marginal of Q_kappa is the corresponding product Bernoulli marginal.
claims.quantifiers: For every admitted theta and kappa, all 63 proper coordinate subsets including the empty subset, and every assignment on that subset.
claims.falsifier: A surviving parity contribution in any proper marginal refutes the claim.

claims.statement: Fixed scalar kappa is equivariant under paired even complements and admitted finite relabelings, but a nonzero scalar is not equivariant under an odd complement unless kappa transforms pseudoscalarly.
claims.quantifiers: For every admitted theta and kappa; pair permutations require identified types, and within-pair swaps are only toy-coordinate symmetries.
claims.falsifier: A failed paired equality or a fixed-nonzero-scalar odd equality refutes the classification.

claims.statement: Singleton extraction composed with the fixed-kappa lift is the identity, so the lift is a smooth rank-six immersion with positive-definite Fisher pullback and zero radical; further quotient conclusions have the stated regularity boundary.
claims.quantifiers: For every fixed admitted kappa on the open theta cube; secondary quotient claims only under their explicit added hypotheses.
claims.falsifier: Failure of the extraction identity, derivative rank, or categorical-Fisher positivity refutes the fixed-kappa claim.

claims.statement: With a common outside marginal, the global VFE difference and normalized conditional directional differential equal the outside-weighted block-local difference and differential.
claims.quantifiers: For every finite two-bit/four-bit split, strictly positive normalized target, pair of strictly positive recognition laws with common outside marginal, and normalized fixed-outside conditional tangent.
claims.falsifier: A scope-satisfying finite KL-chain or tangent counterexample refutes the claim.

claims.statement: The general joint Fisher tensor equals E[ss^T]+E[sR^T]+E[Rs^T]+E[RR^T], and comparison with the product marginal metric retains all signed defects.
claims.quantifiers: For every strictly positive smooth finite joint family parameterized by its six Bernoulli singleton marginals.
claims.falsifier: A failure of the exact score expansion refutes the claim.

claims.statement: In the six-bit parity family, pairwise independence kills the signed Fisher cross defects and E[RR^T] is positive definite for every nonzero kappa.
claims.quantifiers: For every theta in (0,1)^6 and every nonzero fixed |kappa|<1.
claims.falsifier: A nonzero residual-score null vector or nonvanishing cross defect refutes the claim.

claims.statement: At theta_i=1/2 and c=kappa/64, G_joint=4 I6/(1-c^2); at kappa=1/2 the residual is 4 I6/16383.
claims.quantifiers: For every fixed |kappa|<1 at the center, with the stated special value.
claims.falsifier: Any unequal diagonal or nonzero off-diagonal exact sum refutes the claim.

claims.statement: Relative to G_w=diag(w_i/[theta_i(1-theta_i)]), the exact defect is the full signed product-metric defect plus diag((1-w_i)/[theta_i(1-theta_i)]); at the parity center full-tangent equality holds exactly when every w_i=1/(1-c^2).
claims.quantifiers: For every smooth positive family in the general formula and every weights w_i; the iff specialization is at the six-bit parity center.
claims.falsifier: A mismatched exact defect or a different full-tangent center equality condition refutes the claim.

claims.statement: The declared uniform-prior binary hyperedge kernel has evidence 1/2, posterior Q_kappa at the center, correlated-lift VFE log 2, and product-lift excess -log(1-c^2)/2.
claims.quantifiers: For every fixed |kappa|<1 at theta_i=1/2 with c=kappa/64 and record value 1.
claims.falsifier: Failed kernel normalization, evidence, Bayes posterior, or VFE expression refutes the witness.

claims.statement: There exists a strictly positive normalized joint binary-record kernel with the same two marginal kernels as the product construction and zero ab coefficient.
claims.quantifiers: For every functions a,b bounded in absolute value by eta<1/2, pointwise in the conditioning state.
claims.falsifier: Nonpositivity, nonnormalization, changed marginal kernels, or a surviving ab coefficient refutes the construction.

claims.statement: The older two-bit correlated lift has a Fisher correction relative to 4I2 with eigenvalues -4/9 and 4/7.
claims.quantifiers: At the displayed two-bit center with kappa=1/2.
claims.falsifier: A positive-semidefinite correction or different exact eigenvalues refute the witness.

claims.statement: For the promoted amplitude kappa eta, only the product is identifiable and the interaction Fisher block has rank at most one, with rank zero at the origin.
claims.quantifiers: For every admitted theta and redundant interaction parameters on the positivity domain.
claims.falsifier: Two linearly independent interaction derivatives in the displayed promotion refute the claim.

claims.statement: The six singleton sections do not select kappa, full-joint VFE, full-joint Fisher, or a joint record factorization; no canonical, intervention, agency, GL(K), continuum, physical, time/unit, or renormalization conclusion follows from the finite premises.
claims.quantifiers: Across the displayed fixed-singleton lift family and record-kernel controls; excluded conclusions require additional future premises.
claims.falsifier: A unique selection function derived solely from the six singleton laws, or a derivation of an excluded typed structure from the frozen premises, refutes the corresponding boundary.
